newsitem.title: FRANCE: Talks start in TAT-Air Liberte strike in France.
newsitem.headline: Talks start in TAT-Air Liberte strike in France.

text.p: Talks were under way on Monday between unions and British Airways' French airlines Air Liberte and TAT as a strike by the two carriers' cockpit crews stretched into its 13th day.

"Negotiations began at around 3 p.m. (1300 GMT). The principal stumbling block is rest time. We want 10 days of rest a month, but a management proposal made on Saturday is unsatisfactory on this issue, which is key to our decision," a union official said.

TAT and Air Liberte flew just 55 percent of scheduled flights on Monday as the strike wore on, called in protest at BA cost-cutting measures intended to bring the carriers to profitability. The airlines said in a statement they expected 52 percent of scheduled flights to fly on Tuesday.
